subject: c10-it

weightage.label: Part B Unit 1: Digital Documentation, Writer (Ch 2 to 4)
Part B Unit 2: Spreadsheet, Calc (Ch 5 to 8)
Part B Unit 3: Database, Base (Ch 9 to 13)
Part B Unit 4: Healthy, Safe and Secure Working Environment (Ch 14 to 16)

note: Marks are official (Part A 10 + Part B 40 = 50). The other 50 of the 100 marks are practical: Part C practical exam and viva 30 (Writer 5, Calc 5, Base 10, viva 10) and Part D project work 10 and portfolio or practical file 10. The portfolio needs printouts of at least 5 problems each from Writer, Calc and Base.
mistakes: Half the marks are practical, so practise on LibreOffice itself, not only from the book.
Keep the portfolio complete: at least 5 problems each in Writer, Calc and Base, with printouts.
Base: plan the tables, primary keys and relationships before you build queries, forms and reports.
Do not skip the workplace health, safety and security unit. It is 10 marks of theory.
Save your practice files in clearly named folders, so you can find them for the project and the portfolio.
order: Database with Base (Part B Unit 3, 12 marks) first: the largest unit and the most practical hours.
Then Spreadsheet with Calc (10 marks) and the workplace safety unit (10 marks).
Then Employability Skills (Part A, 10 marks, five short units).
Then Digital Documentation with Writer (8 marks).
Work on the project (10) and portfolio (10) all through the year.
